services.title: Custom Shopify Store Development
services.h1: Custom Shopify Store Development for High-Growth Brands
services.metaDescription: Bespoke Shopify store development built from Figma designs with Liquid, modern headless options, zero app bloat, and sub-second loading speeds.
services.heroAnswer: AdsPeek engineers high-converting, custom Shopify storefronts from pixel-perfect Figma designs. We eliminate third-party app dependencies with clean custom Liquid architecture, guaranteed 90+ Core Web Vitals, and tailored conversion funnels built for scaling direct-to-consumer brands globally.
deliverables: Figma-to-Liquid custom theme development with zero boilerplate code
Tailored product page (PDP) variants, sticky carts, and upsell logic
Collection page filtering, facet search, and mega-menu architecture
Third-party ERP, CRM, warehouse, and courier webhook integrations
Cross-browser QA and responsive validation across all mobile viewports
targetAudience: Growing D2C brands outgrowing off-the-shelf Shopify templates
Enterprise retailers seeking custom checkout and ERP integrations
Founders launching new direct-to-consumer product lines

processSteps.title: Discovery & Architecture
processSteps.desc: Technical scoping, catalog structure mapping, and Liquid codebase planning.

processSteps.title: Bespoke Development
processSteps.desc: Modular section development directly in Shopify theme editor.

processSteps.title: Performance QA
processSteps.desc: Rigorous mobile performance, accessibility, and checkout stress testing.

processSteps.title: Launch & Handover
processSteps.desc: DNS cutover, live monitoring, team training, and 30-day post-launch warranty.

services.pricingNote: Custom store builds typically range from $3,000 to $7,000 (₹2,50,000 - ₹5,80,000) based on catalog size and custom functionality.

faqs.q: Do we own 100% of the custom theme code after launch?
faqs.a: Yes. Upon final milestone payment and handover, 100% of the theme code, assets, and Shopify store ownership are transferred directly to your organization with zero proprietary locks.

faqs.q: Can our marketing team edit sections without code after handover?
faqs.a: Every section we build is natively exposed to the Shopify Theme Editor (OS 2.0). Your team can drag, drop, reorder, change copy, and swap media without touching Liquid code.

faqs.q: How long does a typical custom Shopify store build take?
faqs.a: Most bespoke store projects take between 3 to 6 weeks from kickoff to launch, divided into structured milestone sprints.

migrationPlatforms.name: WooCommerce
migrationPlatforms.title: WooCommerce to Shopify Migration
migrationPlatforms.metaDescription: Seamlessly migrate from WooCommerce to Shopify with zero downtime, full customer and order history transfer, and 100% preserved Google SEO rankings.
migrationPlatforms.heroAnswer: Leave WordPress maintenance headaches and plugin vulnerabilities behind. AdsPeek migrates your WooCommerce store to Shopify with zero revenue disruption, full customer data preservation, and airtight 301 redirect mapping to protect your hard-earned SEO authority.
checklist: Products, categories, attributes, and inventory transfer
Customer accounts, addresses, and order history mapping
Payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe, Cashfree, COD) configuration
migrationPlatforms.downtimeGuarantee: Zero customer downtime during DNS cutover
migrationPlatforms.pricingNote: WooCommerce to Shopify migrations start at $2,000 (₹1,60,000).

faqs.q: Can customer passwords be transferred from WooCommerce to Shopify?
faqs.a: Because WooCommerce and Shopify use different encryption hashes, Shopify requires customers to activate their account via an automated one-click email invite upon launch.
